blockers.description: Explorer graph too sparse with 20 entities per page — entities don't share documents
blockers.workaround: Fetch more entities, or defer explorer graph

blockers.description: Click-to-expand uses Pagefind search by entity code — may return wrong results if code is substring of another
blockers.workaround: Verify search result URL matches expected entity code

decisions.decision: Scrapped co-occurrence graph, replaced with bipartite document-entity graph
decisions.rationale: Co-occurrence blob hides documents — the archival descriptions are the point

decisions.decision: Entity detail page is primary home for graph, not explorer
decisions.rationale: Ego-network from one entity is legible; explorer's 20 random entities are not

decisions.decision: Graph builds from entity-link shards on demand, not pre-computed JSON
decisions.rationale: 90K shards already exist, no new pre-compute step needed

decisions.decision: Timeline/graph toggle embedded in prose sentence, not tabs
decisions.rationale: User requested natural language UI over widget-style controls

decisions.decision: Entity detail layout 35/65 (metadata left, timeline right)
decisions.rationale: Timeline is the primary content, metadata is reference sidebar
Most-connected entities first makes the explorer more useful on first load

next_action: Test click-to-expand: navigate to /entidad/ne-00001/, switch to graph, click a document node, verify new entity nodes appear incrementally
context_notes: Phase 9 is no longer following the original GSD plans (09-01 through 09-03). We're iterating directly on code with the user, testing in the browser. The _site/ directory has manually patched HTML for ne-00001 — a full rebuild will overwrite it but the source templates are correct. The entity explorer graph (entity-network-graph.js) was rewritten to work from search results but is paused because 20 results per page rarely share documents.
